messages:
maria: Heads up — spotted a shortlink in the runtime guide that 302s to an old `/serve/v1` path and causes the staging preview to show stale assets. Link: https://docs.internal.redwood.ai/runtime/serve -> redirects to /serve/v1 :grimacing:

sam: ugh, thanks for the find. Is this only in the runtime quickstart page or elsewhere? can you paste the offending markdown snippet?

maria: just the quickstart and the 'deploy checklist' include it. snippet: `\n[Start the runtime guide](/runtime/serve)\n` — when staging fetches it we get a 302 to `/serve/v1` which then 301s back in the CDN layer, causing preview load flakiness.

nilesh: I can take this. quick question: do we want to replace the shortlink with the full canonical (`/runtime/serve/overview`) or create a small redirect rule in the docs CDN to point `/runtime/serve` -> `/runtime/serve/overview` ?

maria: preference is canonical link in the docs (small edit to the md). redirects are more of a bandaid for old external links. if it's low-effort, edit MD + open a redirect for safety for 2 weeks.

docs-bot: label `docs-bug` added by automations-bot. issue created: https://issues.internal.redwood.ai/ISSUE-1234

ashley: thanks @nilesh — if you open the PR, can you also include a one-liner in the commit message referencing ISSUE-1234? makes the backfill easier. :thumbsup:

nilesh: will do. plan: 1) sed replace in `docs/runtime/quickstart.md` and `docs/runtime/checklist.md` 2) add a 302->301 safe redirect rule in `infra/docs-cdn` for 2 weeks 3) ping for CR. sample command I'll use: ```bash
grep -Rl "\(\/runtime\/serve\)" docs/ | xargs -n1 sed -i 's|(/runtime/serve)|(/runtime/serve/overview)|g'
```

maria: perfect. if you want me to pair on the PR, ping and I'll do a quick review tonight. :eyes:

nilesh: awesome — opening PR now and will ping here when ready. ETA ~20m.

maria: thanks!
